reply_text: I replied to Pree in a thread on her correction in #central-team, confirming that the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. I didn't store the correction anywhere else, since she said no action was needed. Her earlier Dock 23 message and my reply to it are still in the channel, so anyone reading only that thread could still pick up the wrong location.
